about.body: The TDV8/SDV8 is a V8, 3.6L / 4.4L, Diesel engine used across Land Rover's 3 model range, in production 2006–2019. We rebuild every TDV8/SDV8 to original specification, replacing worn timing components, bearings, gaskets and seals as standard.

byModel.body: The TDV8/SDV8 is fitted across Discovery, Range Rover, Range Rover Sport — see the full applications table above for exact variants, generations and years.

compatibility.body: Because the TDV8/SDV8 is fitted across multiple Land Rover models, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation and specification. We confirm by registration or VIN before quoting or supplying anything.
